articles.title: Canucks Begin Regular Season on the Road in Edmonton on Tuesday Night
RELEASE: Oilers announce 2026-27 opening night roster
PROJECTED LINEUP: Nugent-Hopkins out for Tuesday's home opener vs. Canucks

out.detail: upper body injury, day to day but expected two weeks per coach Babcock
lower body injury, out for potentially up to two weeks

away.summary: The Oilers open the 2026-27 season with Tristan Jarry confirmed as the starting goalie. They will be without several key players including Zach Hyman (upper body, day-to-day but expected two weeks), Frederik Andersen, Jason Dickinson, Mattias Janmark, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins (lower body, out up to two weeks), Alec Regula, and Matt Savoie. Owen Michaels is set to make his NHL debut, and Vasily Podkolzin is expected to see increased responsibility on the top power play in Nugent-Hopkins' absence.

home.summary: The Canucks begin the season on the road in Edmonton, with Kevin Lankinen projected to start in goal alongside newcomer Leevi Merilainen. They will be without Thatcher Demko (hip) and Filip Chytil (shoulder). The team is expected to dress the same lineup used in their season-opening win over the Oilers, bringing positive momentum from a strong preseason finish.
